<document id="close-statements">
StatementsˆafterˆclosingˆAfterˆyouˆcloseˆyourˆaccount,ˆyouˆcanˆstillˆsignˆinˆandˆdownloadˆstatementsˆforˆ90ˆdays.ˆ##ˆDownloadˆthemˆbeforeˆyouˆgoˆWeˆrecommendˆdownloadingˆanyˆstatementsˆandˆtaxˆformsˆyouˆmightˆneedˆbeforeˆyouˆclose.ˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆDocuments.ˆ##ˆAfterˆthatˆOnceˆtheˆdownloadˆperiodˆends,ˆyouˆcan'tˆsignˆin.ˆMessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheˆsign-inˆscreen,ˆorˆemailˆus,ˆandˆwe'llˆsendˆtheˆstatementsˆyouˆneed.ˆWeˆkeepˆrecordsˆforˆsevenˆyears.ˆ##ˆTaxˆformsˆIfˆyouˆearnedˆatˆleastˆ$10.00ˆinˆinterestˆinˆtheˆyearˆyouˆclosed,ˆweˆstillˆsendˆyourˆ1099-INTˆbyˆJanuaryˆ31.ˆ##ˆVerificationˆlettersˆAccountˆverificationˆlettersˆareˆonlyˆavailableˆforˆopenˆaccounts.ˆ##ˆCardˆandˆtransactionˆhistoryˆYourˆstatementsˆlistˆeveryˆtransaction,ˆfee,ˆinterestˆpaymentˆandˆdisputeˆcreditˆforˆtheˆmonth,ˆsoˆthey'reˆusuallyˆallˆyouˆneedˆforˆrecords,ˆtaxesˆorˆaˆloanˆapplicationˆelsewhere.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="plans-compare">
Compareˆplans:ˆfeaturesˆandˆlimitsˆAllˆthreeˆplansˆcomeˆwithˆaˆVisaˆdebitˆcard,ˆtheˆTallowbrookˆapp,ˆBrookPayˆtransfersˆtoˆotherˆmembers,ˆSavingsˆPocketsˆandˆsupportˆaroundˆtheˆclock.ˆTheyˆdifferˆinˆfees,ˆlimitsˆandˆaˆfewˆfeatures.ˆ|ˆFeatureˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ|---|---|---|---|ˆ|ˆCardˆ|ˆplasticˆ|ˆplasticˆ|ˆmetalˆ|ˆ|ˆSavingsˆAPYˆ|ˆ0.50%ˆ|ˆ2.00%ˆ|ˆ3.75%ˆ|ˆ|ˆCushionˆ|ˆnotˆavailableˆ|ˆupˆtoˆ$50.00ˆ|ˆupˆtoˆ$200ˆ|ˆ|ˆDailyˆcardˆspendingˆ|ˆ$3,000ˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ$10,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆDailyˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆ|ˆ$500ˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ$1,500ˆ|ˆ|ˆDailyˆACHˆtransfersˆoutˆ|ˆ$2,500ˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ$10,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆwiresˆ|ˆnotˆavailableˆ|ˆyesˆ|ˆyesˆ|ˆ|ˆEmergencyˆcardˆabroadˆ|ˆnoˆ|ˆnoˆ|ˆyesˆ|ˆFeesˆareˆlistedˆinˆtheˆarticleˆ"Feesˆforˆallˆplans".ˆThisˆpageˆcoversˆfeaturesˆandˆlimitsˆonly.ˆ##ˆWhichˆplanˆfitsˆBasicˆsuitsˆpeopleˆwhoˆmostlyˆuseˆBrookLinkˆATMsˆandˆdon'tˆtravel.ˆPlusˆsuitsˆpeopleˆwhoˆwantˆCushionˆandˆaˆbetterˆsavingsˆrateˆforˆaˆsmallˆmonthlyˆfee.ˆPremiumˆsuitsˆfrequentˆtravelersˆandˆpeopleˆwithˆlargerˆbalances,ˆsinceˆtheˆsavingsˆrateˆandˆtheˆmissingˆforeignˆfeesˆcanˆmoreˆthanˆcoverˆtheˆmonthlyˆfee.ˆYouˆcanˆswitchˆplansˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="fees-all-v2">
FeesˆforˆallˆplansˆThisˆisˆtheˆfullˆfeeˆscheduleˆforˆallˆthreeˆplans,ˆeffectiveˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆ|ˆFeeˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ|---|---|---|---|ˆ|ˆMonthlyˆfeeˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ$5.00ˆ|ˆ$15.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$2.50ˆ|ˆ$2.50ˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆInternationalˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆForeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆ|ˆ3%ˆ|ˆ1%ˆ|ˆ0%ˆ|ˆ|ˆCardˆreplacementˆ|ˆ$5.00ˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆExpeditedˆcardˆshippingˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆdomesticˆwireˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ$15.00ˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆnotˆavailableˆ|ˆ$35.00ˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆIncomingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆCashˆdepositˆatˆaˆretailˆstoreˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ##ˆNotesˆ-ˆPlusˆincludesˆ3ˆfreeˆout-of-networkˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆeachˆcalendarˆmonth.ˆTheˆfeeˆinˆtheˆtableˆappliesˆafterˆthose.ˆ-ˆPremiumˆreimbursesˆATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆupˆtoˆ$10.00ˆaˆmonth.ˆ-ˆThereˆareˆnoˆoverdraftˆfeesˆ($0.00),ˆnoˆfeesˆforˆreturnedˆtransfersˆandˆnoˆinactivityˆfeesˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ-ˆIncomingˆdomesticˆwiresˆareˆfreeˆ($0.00)ˆonˆeveryˆplan.ˆ-ˆATMˆownersˆcanˆaddˆtheirˆownˆsurcharge.ˆThatˆisˆseparateˆfromˆourˆfee.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
